package.name: pinkrab_teleop
package.description:
The handheld, driving an arm. It reads the marker solid's pose off the top camera's live server, turns how far the hand has moved into where the tool should be, solves the arm for it, and publishes /joint_commands.
Which arm follows is not asked. The solid on the left handheld carries marker ids 0-15 and the right one 16-31, so the handheld that is in frame says which arm it drives, and picking up the other one moves the other arm.
Its own package because it belongs on the operator's side of the rig and drags the camera, the marker solver and the kinematics in with it - none of which the driver holding the servo bus should have to install.
